transcript.content: Hello, thank you for coming in. What brings you here today?

I guess… work’s been getting harder to keep straight. I’m an electrician, and lately I can’t stay focused on one estimate or code form. A tool noise, a text, or some random idea about my workshop pulls me off, and then jobs start getting mixed up. That’s kind of what finally pushed me to come in.
Do you find it hard to focus on tasks or activities at home or in other settings, or is this mainly happening at work?

Mostly work, I guess. That’s where it’s really showing up. Like I’ll be trying to finish an estimate or some code paperwork, and then a tool noise or a text or just some idea about my workshop pulls me off. Then I come back and things are mixed up.
Even if it’s not as noticeable as at work, have you found it hard to stay focused or keep things organized at home or in other parts of your life lately?

A little, yeah. It’s mostly at work, but at home I’ll start trying to sort something out in the workshop and then a text or some random idea pulls me off. Then I come back and I’ve lost track of what I was doing.
Were you also easily distracted or had trouble staying focused on tasks when you were a kid, or is this something that’s mostly started more recently?
No, not really as a kid. This feels more recent… maybe the last seven months or so. It started building after we took on the mortgage for the workshop and equipment.

Have you found yourself making more mistakes at work or at home because you’re not paying close attention to details, or have you had trouble staying focused during tasks even when there aren’t any obvious distractions?

Yeah… that’s kind of what finally made me come in. I’ll be on one estimate or a code form, and then a tool noise, or a text, or some idea about the workshop pulls me off. When I get back to it, I’ve lost the thread, and then the jobs or paperwork start getting mixed up.
Outside of work and your workshop at home, do you find yourself losing focus or getting distracted in other areas of your life, like while driving, reading, or talking with others?

Not really in a big way outside of that. It’s mostly when I’m trying to do estimates or code forms… little things like a tool noise or a text, or just some idea about the workshop, and then I’m off track. Then I come back and the jobs start getting mixed up.
Outside of work and your workshop, do you ever find it hard to stay focused or get distracted easily—like when you’re reading, watching TV, or talking with friends or family?

Not so much with friends or TV, I guess. It’s really the estimates and code forms that get me. A tool noise, a text, or some idea about the workshop pops up, and then I’m off it… and when I come back, the jobs start getting mixed up.
Do you ever have trouble staying focused or get easily distracted when you're in situations like driving, sitting in meetings, or listening to someone talk?

I don’t really notice it as much with driving or listening to people. It’s more with the estimates and code forms. I’ll be focused, then a tool noise or a text—or some idea for the workshop—pulls me off, and when I come back I’ve lost where I was. That’s when things start getting mixed up.
Do you ever find yourself forgetting things often, like appointments, deadlines, or where you put tools or paperwork, even if there wasn’t a distraction pulling you away?
I don’t think so… not often anyway. I mean, I misplace stuff sometimes like anyone, but I haven’t really noticed it being a big thing unless I got pulled off what I was doing.
Have you been feeling down, depressed, or losing interest in things you usually enjoy, even when you’re not distracted by work or other tasks?
I don’t know… not really, I guess. I haven’t been paying attention to that. I still do the usual stuff when I can.

Have you noticed any times when you're trying to follow a conversation, read something, or work on a task unrelated to your job or workshop, and you still find it hard to stay focused or get distracted easily?

Not really outside that stuff… or I haven’t noticed it much. The main thing is the estimates and code forms. I’ll be trying to stay on one, then a tool noise or a text, or some idea about the workshop, pulls me off. Then when I come back, I’ve lost my place and jobs start getting mixed up.
Have you noticed any changes in your mood lately, like feeling down or not getting as much enjoyment out of things as you usually do?
I haven’t really noticed anything like that. I mean, I’m not feeling especially down… things feel about the same, I guess.
Have you been feeling more tired or low on energy lately, even when you're not distracted by work or other tasks?
I’m not sure. I mean, I get tired like anyone, but I haven’t really noticed some big low-energy thing outside of work.
Have you noticed yourself feeling more anxious or worried lately, even when you're not working on estimates or code forms?
Not really… I mean, I worry about work stuff when I’m in it, but outside of that I haven’t noticed being more anxious or anything.
Have you noticed any trouble staying focused or getting distracted when you're doing something that requires attention, like a hobby, a game, or even just having a conversation with someone?

Yeah… that’s actually been a problem. Like with estimates or code forms, I’ll be trying to stay on one thing, and then a tool noise, or a text, or even some idea about the workshop comes up and I’m off track. Then I come back and stuff’s mixed up. That’s kind of what pushed me to come in.

Outside of work, do you find it hard to stay focused during conversations, hobbies, or activities that require attention, or do these issues only happen when you’re working on estimates or code forms?

Mostly it’s when I’m doing the estimates or code forms. That’s where it really shows up. I’ll be on one thing, then a tool noise or a text or some idea about the workshop pulls me off, and when I come back, I’ve got jobs mixed up. Outside of that… I don’t know, I haven’t noticed it as much.
Have you noticed any trouble staying focused or getting distracted when you're doing something that requires thinking or problem-solving, like reading, planning, or even just having a conversation?

Yeah… mostly with the stuff that needs me to keep track of details. Like estimates or code forms. I’ll be on one job, then a tool noise or a text comes in, or I get some idea about the workshop, and I’m just… off it. Then when I come back, things get mixed up. That’s really why I came in.

Have you noticed any trouble staying focused or getting distracted when you're in situations that require thinking or problem-solving, like reading a book, having a conversation, or planning something out?

Yeah… like I said, it’s mostly with the estimates and code forms. I’ll be trying to stay on one job, and then some tool noise, or a text, or I get some idea about the workshop, and I’m off it. When I come back, I start mixing jobs up. That’s… kind of why I came in.
